units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣也获悉了此事。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, also learned of this matter.

units.source_text: 隔了一会，夕雾前来参见，容貌比以前更加光彩了。

en.t: After a little while, Yugiri came to pay his respects, looking even more radiant than before.

units.source_text: 源氏向他打量一下，说道：“今天早上怎么样？

en.t: Genji looked him over and said, "How did things go this morning?
Did you send the letter of sympathy?

units.source_text: 为了女人之事，贤者亦难免错乱。

en.t: When it comes to women, even a wise man can hardly avoid losing his composure.

units.source_text: 多年以来，你能不做强项放肆之事，不露焦躁愠怒之色，直至今日，此心确是与众不同，深可嘉许。

en.t: For all these years, you have avoided stubborn and reckless behavior, and have shown no sign of impatience or anger down to this day; such a heart is truly exceptional and deeply worthy of praise.

units.source_text: 内大臣为人，一向刚愎自用，不屈不挠。

en.t: The Inner Minister has always been obstinate, self-willed, and unwilling to bend.

units.source_text: 此次忽然卑躬屈节，世人必然纷纷议论。

en.t: If he suddenly humbles himself and yields this time, people will surely talk about it everywhere.

units.source_text: 但你切不可为了占胜而扬扬得意，盛气凌人，因而养成浮薄之心。

en.t: But you must not become smug because you have gained the upper hand, nor act arrogantly toward others and thereby develop a shallow spirit.

units.source_text: 内大臣看似落落大方，倜傥不羁，其实并无豪雄之气，却有迂腐之癖，是个难与交往之人。”

en.t: The Inner Minister may seem broad-minded, spirited, and unconventional, but in truth he has no heroic grandeur; instead he has a pedantic streak and is a difficult man to deal with."
This was one of his customary lectures.

units.source_text: 他觉得这段婚事如意称心，十全其美。

en.t: He felt that this marriage was entirely to his liking and perfect in every way.

units.source_text: 源氏大臣生得年轻，不像是夕雾的父亲，倒像是个略长几岁的哥哥。

en.t: Minister Genji looked so youthful by nature that he seemed less like Yugiri's father than an elder brother only a few years older.

units.source_text: 分别看时，两人相貌惟妙惟肖，完全相同；

en.t: Seen separately, the two looked so perfectly alike that their features seemed exactly the same;

units.source_text: 父子在一起时，则互有不同，而并皆美妙。

en.t: yet when father and son were together, each had his own distinct quality, and both were wonderfully beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏大臣身穿淡色常礼服，内衬唐装式的白色内衣，花纹鲜明而晶莹。

en.t: Minister Genji wore a pale-colored everyday court robe, with a Chinese-style white undergarment beneath it, its pattern clear and luminous.

units.source_text: 他今年三十九岁，相貌还是清秀而优雅。

en.t: He was thirty-nine this year, and his appearance was still refined, handsome, and graceful.

units.source_text: 夕雾身穿色彩稍深的常礼服，内衬染成浓丁香汁色纹样的可爱的白绫衫子，别有风度，非常艳丽。

en.t: Yugiri wore an everyday court robe in a slightly deeper shade, with a charming white twill under-robe patterned in a rich clove-dye color beneath it; he had a distinctive elegance and looked exceedingly splendid.
